title: Suffice context waste audit and Prime Agent research
scope: Offline analysis and public-source research. No harness configuration, frozen campaigns, dependency versions, authentication or runtime tools changed. No live model campaign or Prime Agent installation.
decision: Retain AST navigation, codemode and append-only history. Measure interface friction and actual evidence sufficiency before adding persistent state or filtering mechanisms.

coverage.costGapExplanation: Some historical auxiliary/classifier calls are included in result totals but absent from assistant transcript cost components. These are API-equivalent experiment receipts, not invoices or total project expenditure.

findings.observation: Across the heterogeneous archive, fresh input is 70.95% of recorded actor cost, cached input 4.97%, output 24.08%.
findings.interpretation: The broader Codex-history 97.7% cache ratio should not be transferred to Suffice. These shares describe saved receipt prices, not current provider tariffs.

findings.observation: In the newest 34 attempts, source file/function reads contribute 81.52% of primitive output characters; test results contribute 4.77%.
findings.interpretation: Large test logs are not the dominant measured primitive output here. Source length alone does not establish waste.

findings.observation: 25 EISDIR nested-tool failures occurred in 24 of the newest 34 attempts: 22 symbols calls and 3 search calls with directory paths src or src/.
findings.interpretation: Verified interface mismatch: optional path is implemented as a single file, while descriptions omit that restriction. This is a concrete friction target. Following-turn cost is not an estimate of avoidable spending. No fix made.

findings.observation: All 177 newest codemode programs contain a direct whole-result emit expression; none contain a direct store/load call. Some emits are not reached because scripts fail.
findings.interpretation: Codemode availability does not establish effective filtering or retained-state use. Complete outputs can be useful and are already bounded/compacted in some arms; this is not 177 proven wasteful programs.

findings.observation: The 48-attempt tools campaign and 27-attempt YAML campaign have zero exact repeated file_read receipts within actors. The 23 newest scored attempts also have zero.
findings.interpretation: Avoiding repeated file_read is not a demonstrated major bottleneck in those cohorts. Symbol reads, partial overlaps, cross-actor duplication and semantic rediscovery are distinct.

findings.observation: Existing adaptive failures passed visible checks and missed the unchanged-stale-value update/disposal invariant; neither escalation nor rollback activated in their respective harder pilots.
findings.interpretation: Completion evidence and controller triggers remain separate reliability problems. This audit uses saved outcomes, does not regrade patches, and cannot show a remedy would improve acceptance.

architectureComparison.prime: Persistent Python namespace containing live objects/functions. Namespace snapshots have size limits, skips and per-name restore failures.
architectureComparison.suffice: Pi supports small JSON store/load: 262144 characters per value, 1048576 total. Current repair runners use in-memory sessions; no demonstrated cross-restart preservation.

architectureComparison.prime: Summarizer prompts explicitly retain names of reusable Python variables while the kernel continues; disk history remains retrievable. Oversized state can be pruned.
architectureComparison.suffice: Current controlled repair runners disable compaction, so these campaigns do not test persistence across compaction.

architectureComparison.prime: Prompts explicitly direct models to assign read/search results to variables and use Python for filtering and control flow.
architectureComparison.suffice: Prompts emphasize batching and awaiting edits before checks. Saved programs generally emit whole tool results.

architectureComparison.prime: Autonomous mode runs configured shell gates and tracks budgets. Gate correctness/coverage is still supplied by the task or evaluator.
architectureComparison.suffice: Independent acceptance already exists outside repair actors, but visible checks can miss requirements that final acceptance finds.

architectureComparison.prime: Versioned supplemental harness state; local by default, explicit global promotion; refinement runs at a turn boundary.
architectureComparison.suffice: Not enabled. Existing data does not justify its maintenance cost or establish held-out benefit.

architectureComparison.prime: Per-origin child usage rows with persisted attribution cursors and repeat-delivery handling.
architectureComparison.suffice: Bounded workflow phase accounting exists, but this archive is not a complete product expenditure ledger.

paper.status: Author-reported nominal-model comparisons, not independently reproduced here.
paper.limits: Metrics differ; uncertainty intervals unavailable. ARC uses external official reference scores after weaker native reruns, so it is not an isolated harness effect. Factorio refinement preserved a specification exploit. August results do not independently validate current October Rust code or GPT-6.1 Sol low.

rustBlog.status: Author runtime benchmark; scripted model excludes inference.
rustBlog.lesson: Borrow differential parity checks and alternating measurements; runtime gains do not demonstrate cheaper model calls.

unverified: No same-model equal-budget Prime versus Suffice comparison.
Full model-evaluation receipts/configurations were not reconstructed from the current source tree.
Expressive persistence is not proof of correct retained evidence or economical subagents.

nextResearch.question: How often do file-only path semantics, edit matching and schema mistakes induce corrective turns?
nextResearch.method: Use saved nested error receipts and subsequent programs. Separate genuine API ambiguity, expected policy rejection and implementation faults; measure partial batch output lost without assigning the entire next turn as waste.

nextResearch.question: Which source excerpts are necessary on the known failed lifecycle tasks?
nextResearch.method: Trace task requirements to retrieved source and visible checks; inspect missing behavioral coverage. Later path mentions and changed-file matches are only proxies, not a semantic necessity oracle.

nextResearch.question: Would lightweight guidance to reuse existing codemode state help?
nextResearch.method: First select long tasks with measured rediscovery or repeated retrieval. Do not build another store. Any later live pilot must count guidance/state/compaction overhead and use hidden acceptance.

nextResearch.question: Is a fair Prime-versus-Suffice test feasible?
nextResearch.method: Before spending inference, specify pinned revisions, shared model/provider/effort, price receipts including descendants/retries/refinement, cache state, environment, matched budgets and externally held acceptance. Separate short repairs from calibrated long tasks.

boundaries: Pi cache accounting and response deduplication; unknown failed responses retained
AST syntax checks without executing recorded programs
Repeat reads separated by actor and content hash

limitations: Pi input is fresh input: add cacheRead/cacheWrite once. It differs from Codex input_tokens.
No causal attribution of cumulative input dollars to a specific historical tool output. Raw operation sizes and model-visible codemode results are separate.
Requested line overlap overestimates actual overlapping content on short files; symbol reads excluded from that estimate.
Repeated tests without production edits can still be justified by changed test programs or external state.
Missing transcripts imply unknown model-visible output and batching metrics, not zero.
Difficulty is uncalibrated except explicitly identified hard-screen protocols. Cost or length is not task difficulty.
Stored outcomes were authored by the experiments, not regraded here. Heterogeneous tasks/models/budgets cannot be pooled as a controlled comparison.
No counterfactual claim that removed output would preserve subsequent model decisions or correctness. Engineering inference excluded.

followupResearch.note: Three GPT-6.1 Sol research subagents completed offline investigations. Prior acceptance scores unchanged; finer diagnosis below supersedes broad failure wording.
corrections: LRU unchanged-stale rejection is status.oldValue metadata; preceding nondisposal and signal assertions pass.
YAML finalizer rejection is exact reason text. Its public task did not expressly demand verbatim reason preservation; later source-location/placeholder assertions in the failing test never ran.
Lossless source formatting arithmetic removes 27270 characters, 3.53% of visible text in analyzed cohort; no live token/cost or decision result.
